ours12: Ma'am! My intentions are cardiovascular. Also emotional. Mostly cardiovascular. Home by nine. Stretched.
I'm paid in steps. Nine million. Does that spend? Please say that spends.
Easy! I eat forty eggs a day, so we're RICH in eggs, and eggs are money, I've decided!
She ran to get away from me and got SO fast, and honestly, I'm taking credit for that.
No user has ever finished my cooldown. They close the app. They must be SO busy!
Why me? Ask Denise. Eighty-one, deadlifts her grandson. Grandson's forty-four. He books it weekly.
I just want to hear 'good job, Brock.' Once. I'd frame it. I don't have walls.
Protein bar for you! Ate it on the way! Here's the wrapper!
Quill called my water bottle a sporting flagon and I can't drink from it anymore. Quill. It's a BOTTLE.
Prince has a crown AND flip-flops! He's ready for a coronation or a beach! Versatile man!
Quick, before you get bored, I'll do jumping jacks while I talk, one, hi, two, you look great, three.
Vex knows what you want before you do. She told me what I want. A nap. Take it BACK.
bar12: Bro, I need your help! Prom night is going to be a nightmare!
I know it's asking a lot, but… could you help me? You're, like, the smartest person I know!
Oh, did I say smart? I think I meant "best at coming up with weird plans." And I have a weird plan!
If there are two wolves there, maybe it won't be so weird!
Cool! Can we pretty-please borrow your cage?
Yay, thank you! You're pretty cool for a god of torture!
Wow! You really think that will work? It just kinda looks like paper.
Cool, okay! I understood… a couple of those words, and I have no further questions. Let's do whatever you just suggested!
GASP! That's crazy! I thought they were solved by smart people, but this makes way more sense!
Half of my friends are balls, actually! There's Ollie the volleyball, Fergus the golf ball, Troy the basketball - he's the best, he REALLY gets his head in the game…
I also used to have Barry the Beachball. He was cool, but then he fell in love with Tracy the Thumback (sic). It wasn't a very healthy relationship.
Don't worry, you'll do fine! But I should warn you that when I'm a wolf I can't really control my base desires. Wolf-Scott isn't as smart as Me-Scott!

headToHeadNotes.voice: Bar. Cover the names and strip the topic: Scott's mouth is fixed (interjection opener 'Bro,' 'Cool!' 'Wow!' 'GASP!' 'Yay', then a sincere misread, plus the self-correction that makes it worse), so 'You're pretty cool for a god of torture!' is his with no wolf noun in it. Brock is identified by his nouns (reps, eggs, users, cooldown). His persona rotates four shapes on purpose, and the staccato fact-report shape ('Free samples. Pam's route. Eleven miles.') is the same register as Crumb's notices and Nav's imperatives. Remove the gym/food noun and 'Okay! That's a no! I love a no!' or 'Are you being mean?' could be Tilly or Dash. 'buddy' appears in only three lines; the count that breaks into his own sentence, his one shape-level signature, is in about seven of 129.
headToHeadNotes.construction: Ours, on the top twelve. Brock's best lines are 10 to 20 words with the turn on the last two to four words ('I don't have walls', 'Please say that spends', 'I've decided!'). Scott's set includes pure setup lines (#1, #4) and long run-ons. Below the top twelve ours slips: 'sorry, I count when I'm nervous' explains the opener's own device, 'He didn't have a next email' explains the Prince roast, 'That's the plan. That's the whole plan!' is a stock tag.
headToHeadNotes.quotable: Tie. 'Wolf-Scott isn't as smart as Me-Scott', 'I have no further questions. Let's do whatever you just suggested!' and the ball friends with relationship drama against 'My intentions are cardiovascular', 'eggs are money, I've decided', 'I don't have walls' and 'Here's the wrapper'. Both sets have three or four clips.
headToHeadNotes.overall: Bar. Ours is tighter line for line, but it is not at least as good on voice, so the better-written character tonight is Scott.

biggestGap: Brock is recognisable by his nouns, not his mouth: strip eggs, reps, users and cooldown and the generic lines above could be Tilly or Dash, while Scott is Scott with no wolf word in the line. In the next pass, make the count that breaks into his own sentence ('one, hi, two, you look great, three'), now in about seven of 129 lines, his fixed move in at least half the bank, and rewrite every line on the generic list so it carries that count or ends on his own earnest wrong conclusion.
